title: Will price hikes force Apple to stop dragging its feet on certain product upgrades? - 9to5Mac
summary: With some of Apple’s products, they haven’t changed much in quite some time. iPad Air has kept the same design and feature set since 2020 – only gaining chip upgrades and Apple Pencil Pro since.
